form1938.title: A named land and sea unit for each of seven great powers, far stronger than any other: Yamato and O-I, USS Iowa and T28, Sovetsky Soyuz and T-42, Bismarck and Maus, HMS Hood and TOG II, Richelieu and Char 2C, Roma and P.100 Ercole. They heal, and come back 60 days after they are lost.
